body:
Bench pre-release. For the first time, both cameras and the MG24 deliver live data end to end through the XIAO relays. Live gates still fail on latency and age tails, so launch is still **no**.

## Live run 5 (2026-11-11, 15:35–15:45 PST, `live-2026-11-10`)

| Gate | Camera 1 (Relay 2) | Camera 2 (Relay 1) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fps median / floor | 1.0 / 0.9 PASS | 1.0 PASS / 0.6 **FAIL** |
| age p95 | 1183 ms **FAIL** (≤1000) | 1301 ms PASS (≤1500) |
| age max | 1328 ms PASS (≤1500) | 3180 ms **FAIL** (≤2000) |
| latency p95 | 557 ms **FAIL** (≤120) | 758 ms **FAIL** (≤350) |
| uptime / reconnects / gaps | 100% / 0 / 0 PASS | 99.15% / 0 / 0 PASS |

- MG24: 4.0 Hz PASS, 97.96% valid PASS, longest outage 0.0 s PASS, age p95 694 ms **FAIL** (≤500).
- Samples / poll errors: 587 / 0% PASS. Audio and voice were not recorded.

Results: `bench/results/2026-11-11-live-5/`.

## Deployed images

- Relay 1: `fa51d08`. Accept gated on ALPN, MG24 published off the NimBLE task, NimBLE pools in PSRAM. Minimum free internal RAM went from 2,787 B to 11,635 B.
- Relay 2: `ad37317`.
- MG24: app 1.0.18 with the OLED recovery (`bd1e89d`).

## Main changes since v0.1.0

- Relays no longer reject MoQ sessions with `invalid value`. Accept used to start before TLS reported the ALPN (`ad37317`).
- MG24 BLE: bounded CCCD subscription, accepts an already-negotiated MTU, and no `nimble_host` stack overflow.
- Relay 1 internal-RAM headroom (`fa51d08`), and bounded `accept-diag` diagnostics (`4f48039`).
- Flash records for every one-time app-only deployment, live runs 1–5, and Mac host benchmarks.
- README status shows live run 5 per gate. Open work is in `quests/`.
- Workspace version 0.2.0. Full notes are in `CHANGELOG.md`.

No firmware binaries are attached.
